The test passes. 

## Summary

I implemented a stage filter that narrows the all-invoices list to a single status, following the app's additive conventions (no page or scaffolding edits). All invoices are already loaded client-side, so the feature is a pure front-end change keyed off the URL — no schema or server change was needed.

New/changed files:

1. **`slots/defs/allInvoicesToolbar.ts`** (new) — declares a toolbar region above the cross-project invoices list (`invoices.all.toolbar`), since none existed yet (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

2. **`features/invoices/status-filter.slot.tsx`** (new) — a self-contained `*.slot.tsx` control filling that region. It renders the `invoice-status-filter` `<select>` and owns the `invoiceStatus` URL search param (rule 4).

3. **`features/invoices/queries.ts`** — added the `INVOICE_STATUS_PARAM` key and the `INVOICE_STATUSES` list (DRAFT/SENT/PAID) the filter offers.

4. **`features/invoices/AllInvoicesTable.tsx`** — renders `<AllInvoicesToolbar.Slot />` and reads the same `invoiceStatus` key to drop rows at any other stage. The filter and list stay in step purely through the shared URL key — no callbacks or shared component state.

The `data-testid="invoice-status-filter"` anchor and existing `invoice-row-*` anchors match the spec exactly, and `bin/e2e` passes (3 rows → 2 SENT rows after selecting `SENT`).
